title: Chapter 924
paragraphs: Chapter 924
Episode 230: Invasion and Attack (5)
'Just now, Paelleito did not give his all against Sir Hedo. He concentrated all his killing intent on me while attacking Sir Hedo.'
Yet, Hedo nearly suffered a fatal wound.
Or he could have died. If Paelleito had poured all his hatred into Hedo, he would have undoubtedly suffered a fatal wound or died.
Naturally, Paelleito is stronger than anyone else on the battlefield right now.
But the reason the gap feels so wide is because none of us know Paelleito at all. We hardly know anything about his swordsmanship, how he uses his power.
Although we have some information from Biseps and Orgal, it's not detailed.
'The sword that almost killed Sir Hedo had the ability to disrupt the senses. Sir Hedo perceived his posture to have collapsed and tried to force a correction, revealing a vulnerability.'
Jin understood the characteristics of the nether sword before Hedo explained them. All four people confronting him now did the same.

Just now, Bane Ayura's spear completely disintegrated into particles and disappeared somewhere. The remaining spears orbited around Paelleito, ready to be shot at any moment, and Hedo distanced himself to check his wounds.
Fortunately, he didn't feel any poison from the wound. The battle could continue without any issues.
Kudududuk…!
The ground shook every time Paelleito released his magic power. Rocks burst into dust and shattered, and everyone felt their bodies grow heavy.
As soon as Paelleito's sword moved again, Ayura's spears responded.
Spears descending at a speed that distorted space mixed with the sword qi released by Paelleito's will.
He's strong.
If he wasn't Zito's dog, I'd want to send him respect and praise. Jin couldn't understand how such a strong person couldn't overcome Zito's brainwashing.
"For Lord Zito, not just Sakiel but I also can give everything. That is the most right fate for us, the demons of Jinma."
The moment two more spears disappeared, Jin made a breakthrough and thrust at the speed of light.
A dark flash grazed Paelleito's ear. The difference was not even a finger's breadth, but it wasn't a result of a close miss.
It was a huge discrepancy, to the point where it was doubtful whether it could be narrowed. Not just Jin's attack, but also Murakan's, Hedo's, Dante's - all their attacks were missing like that.
It felt like striking illusions.
Our party is overwhelmed by Paelleito in terms of power, speed, and destructive force. The continuous disruption of the senses by the nether sword made it even worse.
Those who faced the sword of netherworld had to constantly doubt themselves.
Even the four who are known as the superhumans among the superhumans couldn't be sure of their own senses and perception.

So there were always people like Hedo who would lose their balance. Every time that happened, the other companions and Ayura's spears protected him, but if the battle continued like this, Paelleto would eventually take the advantage.
"I've heard from Orgal that you were once the leader of the resistance in the Demon Realm against Zito. That rubbish deterministic philosophy is nothing more than a means to justify your corruption."
Zing!
Jin deflected Ayura's spear that bounced towards him. As he barely blocked Paelleto's onslaught, he saw the dark swirling eyes of the latter, filled with anger and resentment.
'...Demon Eye!'
He wasn't exactly sure what effects this Demon Eye had.
But the signals of crisis his body was sending were clear. Jin averted his gaze and increased the distance, and his companions threw themselves into the breach to cover him.
"Kuk…!"
However, he wasn't completely safe. Out of nowhere, spears made of magi in a violet color started forming in the air. These spears were aimed solely at Jin.
Cloning.
It was a power of the 'Abyss Eye', unique to the Belgasium family. Now, Paelleto had cloned Ayura's spear.

'He cloned using the power of Demon Eye. It's not exactly as powerful as the real Ayura's spear. I can fight while blocking it enough. But, the problem is that he can keep cloning other powers through the Demon Eye.'
The moment Jin had that thought, Paelleto was already cloning the spiritual barrier Murakan had set up. The black spiritual barrier and the violet one overlapped, with the two powers intertwining.
The cloned barrier was emitting the same dark energy as the original one. Although it was less powerful compared to the original, it certainly wasn't at a level that could be ignored.
It was less powerful than the original, but it was still a deadly technique that could threaten the life of an average superhuman.
"I didn't fall into corruption, I found my place. If the world wasn't chaotic in the first place, Sakiel would never have died, let alone by the hands of a human."
Only one of Ayura's spears was left.
That, too, had no significant meaning. During the shattering of the nineteen spears, Paelleto had not allowed a single effective hit from those spears.
The cloned spears also couldn't injure Jin, but if Paelleto started to attack Jin seriously, it was inevitable to get hurt.
They needed more people.
Such a thought was brushing past Jin's mind. The notion that they couldn't possibly finish Paelito off with only the four of them, who had come to aid the kingdom.
In retrospect, that was the nature of 'Changseong'. A realm where one couldn't imagine being in a disadvantageous position, regardless of the situation.
This was true for Sirone and Ban. Even if all the superhumans of the Alliance were to fight either of them, Jin couldn't imagine them being pushed back.
Actual combat might yield a different result, but from just speculation and perception, such a scene could not be drawn.
An incredibly strong existence beyond calculation, that was what they called the realm of Changseong.
'I thought that since I also have Changseong in front of me, I might be able to break it with these colleagues. But there's nothing we can do if the world is different.'
The world is different.
No matter how close one got, no matter how similar the power one possessed, Changseong and everything below it was a different world.
The same things appeared differently, and the same phenomena approached differently. There was such a large gap between the sense of battle Paelito had and that of Jin and his comrades.

Still, having experienced the sensation of Ban, who is unquestionably the strongest in the history of Changseong, Jin could somewhat fathom Paelito's perspective. The way he approached the battle, his senses.
Moreover, Jin was certain.

'The demonic eye that duplicates power or the black that disturbs senses is definitely dangerous, but compared to my father or the God Brothers, I can't erase the feeling of crudeness. It's the brainwashing that has lowered his rank.'
If they continued to dig into that fact, the answer would start to become clearer.
'First, we'll hold out while avoiding fatal wounds until our sisters and other superhumans from the Alliance tidy up the territory and send support.'
Chiing-!
Dante's Heavenly Sword was blocking Paelito, who was rushing towards Jin. Using his Dragon Armor, Dante blocked his counterattack and swung Rashid once more.
Everyone in the party was thinking the same as Jin. Dante was measuring Paelito while thinking of his grandfather, Hedo was thinking of Sirone, and Murakan was thinking of Temar.

They were relieved by the fact that he was weaker than them. Then, they would be able to bring him down in some way. Whether they wait for support, stimulate his brainwashed mind, or create an opportunity to shatter him head-on by pouring out everything.
God fusion.
That was the first thing that came to mind. If they could use the God fusion, which even overpowered Hyungsins, they could quickly turn the tides.
But Paelito had been mindful of that fact from the beginning when he went after the kingdom.

The fact that he blocked communications and spatial leaps meant that 'wave tracking' was completely blocked. Since God fusion was based on the principle of wave tracking, they couldn't even attempt it until the block was lifted.

"When you were dealing with the abomination born from incest, you borrowed a tremendous power that humans should not possess. The power of the descendant of the Myeongwang clan, called Ban. I can acknowledge that the Myeongwang clan possesses such power. They were born with such a fate. But do you humans dare to say that you surpass me, a being who has overcome the extreme?"
Crunch-!

Paelleto's blow crushed Jin. Briefly immobilized while blocking the attack, Jin felt two duplicate spears graze his side and thigh. If his companions hadn't disrupted their trajectories, he would have suffered serious injury.
"Kaahh...!"
Paelleto and Jin's energies were entwined. Amid the explosions erasing the surrounding landscape, his comrades strained to rush in and pry Paelleto away.

"How long do you think it took for me to reach the peak? Over ten thousand years. We have been accumulating power even before your human race appeared in this world, and we have been struggling tirelessly even as humanity repeats the cycle of extinction and regeneration. In that long and distant history, only two have reached the peak, including me."
Boom! The ground on which Jin stood sank.

"But in the history of humanity, already more than four have reached the peak, emerging from beings born with such fragile physicality and barely a century's lifespan... This is the very definition of disorder. It might be unfair to you. You're merely living your lives when suddenly those babbling about order appear and try to oppress you."
"Heh, you know well... Paelleto."

"But even you would kill an ant colony that establishes itself in your city, and you would crush slaves who revolt. You deny fate and order, but you only accept biasedly when it benefits you. That's why we need an absolute order."
Crash, creak!
Finally, his comrades penetrated Paelleto's sword energy and reached Jin.
Jin took this opportunity to push Paelleto away, but even in that moment, Paelleto struck Jin's face with his sword. The blade grazed his cheek, splattering crimson blood.
As Paelleto receded, Jin amplified the energy of the Kwangsimjang.

It was to unfold the Myeongwang Gunlim Sword. His plan was to eliminate the duplicate spears with the Myeongwang Gunlim Sword first, and restrict the battlefield further to prevent Paelleto from rampaging freely.
But moments later, Jin had to clench the Kwangsimjang in surprise.
'My energy, it's not forming!'
-[Paelleto Belgasyeom is his name. He is known as a sword demon in the demon world, and his sword Baskala has the ability to block authority. I was defeated without being able to properly retaliate.]
Orugal's words suddenly came to mind.
Jin had been aware of this fact throughout the battle, but he never imagined that Baskala could even block the power of the Kwangsimjang.
To Jin's understanding, this was definitely not authority but his own genuine power. He was able to use it without any issue during the battle until now.
With a blank expression on his face, Paelleto simply said,
"Didn't I just tell you, Jin Run Kandel. Humans have neither the right to possess nor use such power."
